description: Create (first call) or read the SIP address and private trunk credentials for one of the signed-in owner's answering lines. Use it when the owner's phone system can send calls to a SIP address instead of forwarding a number; for the line's number and forwarding codes use get_answering_line. Any phone system that can send a call to a SIP address can send calls here with no phone number. SIP calls use the line's normal allowance or prepaid minute/outcome balance, with no separate SIP price. Keep the returned username and password private. Needs lines:manage.
name: get_sip_address
title: Your line's SIP address
